The '''Locris sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Carcel]], [[Jweab VII]], [[Pirin]], [[Sermeria]], [[Ter Abbes]], and [[Von-Alai]].
